claims.claim: The exemption ceiling is 5,654 NIS per month for tax years 2024 to 2027
The exemption comes from the Income Tax (Exemption from Tax on Income from Renting a Residential Apartment) Law, 5750-1990

claims.claim: The exemption reaches zero when rent is 11,308 NIS a month or more (2026)
claims.raw_snippet: סך כל ההכנסות משכר הדירה נמוך מ-11,308 ₪ לחודש

claims.claim: The exemption needs rent from a flat used as a residence by an individual tenant

claims.raw_snippet: למעט דירה הרשומה או שיש לרשמה בפנקסים שחייבים לנהל לגבי הכנסת המשכיר מעסק

claims.claim: Section 122 lets an individual pay 10% of residential rent income only if it is not business income

claims.claim: The 10% tax is paid within 30 days of the end of the tax year unless advances were paid
